items.title: RFWash
items.subtitle: Radio-based Hand Hygiene Monitoring
items.description: A millimeter-wave radar-based system for automatic hand hygiene monitoring in healthcare settings. Demonstrated at SenSys 2020.

items.title: WiRelax
items.subtitle: WiFi-based Relaxation Monitoring
items.description: A WiFi-based system for non-intrusive relaxation and stress monitoring using channel state information.
